Advanced elemental damage system with resonance accumulation and threshold effects for NeoForge 1.21.1

Get Started
API Reference
View on GitHub
🌟

13 Elemental Types

Fire, Physical, Wind, Earth, Water, Ice, Electric, Energy, Natural, Quantum, Ether, Light, and Shadow — each with unique threshold effects.

📊

Resonance Accumulation

Track elemental damage accumulation with configurable thresholds and decay timers.

⚡

Threshold Effects

Powerful effects trigger when thresholds are reached — armor penetration, stun, freeze, burn, and more.

📦

Datapack Support

Configure weapons, armor resistances, and mob behaviors through datapacks without code changes.

🔌

External API

Full integration API for other mods — register modifiers, customize damage processing, and extend behavior.

💥

Visual Feedback

Floating damage numbers, status indicators with text displays, and configurable spawn radius.
